41:30.text: Verily, those who say: "Our Lord is Allâh
on them the angels will descend
: "Fear not, nor grieve! But receive the glad tidings of Paradise which you have been promised!

41:31.text: "We have been your friends in the life of this world and are
in the Hereafter. Therein you shall have
that your inner-selves desire, and therein you shall have

41:33.text: And who is better in speech than he who
[says: "My Lord is Allâh (believes in His Oneness)," and then stands firm (acts upon His Order), and]
, and does righteous deeds, and says: "I am one of the Muslims."

41:34.text: The good deed and the evil deed cannot be equal. Repel
(i.e. Allâh orders the faithful believers to be patient at the time of anger,[2] and to excuse those who treat them badly)
then verily he, between whom and you there was enmity,
as though he was a close friend.

41:35.text: except those who are patient - and none is granted it except the owner of the great portion
(of happiness in the Hereafter i.e. Paradise and of a high moral character)

41:36.text: And if an evil whisper from Shaitân
, then seek refuge in Allâh. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

41:37.text: And from among His Signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Prostrate yourselves not to the sun nor to the moon, but prostrate yourselves to Allâh Who created them, if you

41:38.text: But if they are too proud
, then there are those who are with your Lord
glorify Him night and day, and never are they tired.
